# Character artwork

Updated 2026-10-23. Artwork is keyed by character name in app.js and follows that character through ranking changes.

- `Stecher-hero.webp`: AI-enhanced fantasy illustration based on the official `Stecher.png` character portrait, visually checked against https://siel.tools/eu/atiel/Stecher. Female assassin; black hair, silver mask, silver armor and blue shoulder details.
- `LordSanchez2-hero.webp`: AI-enhanced fantasy illustration based on the official `LordSanchez2.png` portrait, checked against https://siel.tools/eu/atiel/LordSanchez2. Silver winged helmet, blue gem, long white beard, dark armor and fur.
- FumosLee, BrouceLee, S7onedMonkey and Roctopus use their existing official game portrait PNGs, replacing mockup face crops. Mocro uses the public NC profile image already configured in portraits.js, with the existing avatar as fallback.
- NaminiLee, JKLee and SurfingLee retain the approved high-resolution triptych illustration.

Illustrations are decorative interpretations of the characters, not evidence of game statistics. AION 2 character designs belong to NCSOFT. No portrait changes write to the historical data or snapshot archive.

`crystal-medal-1.svg`, `crystal-medal-2.svg`, and `crystal-medal-3.svg` are original vector UI ornaments. Their ranks are rendered independently of the character portraits.
